set.body: Cold review of fcba42c50 (S4), finding 4. PromotionError.Contested(reason: String), Embedded(enclosing: String) and BindingOutsideUtterance(reason: String) carry free text; consumers cannot tell a Deception refusal from a root negation without parsing (rules 2, 7). Introduce typed sub-enums (at least ContestationGround: RootRival, SpeechRival, Hypothesis, Record(basis)) and match on them in tests. Public vocabulary change: needs an ADR 0026 amendment line.
set.title: S4 follow-up: typed contestation and embedding reasons in PromotionError
